belayer.description: Who held the rope; absent when nobody was named

AscentRequest.description: A clean ascent is topped, with 0 falls.

belayerId.description: Who held the rope: an active club member, not me

Attendance.description: Ascents over a period, topped or not.

successPercent.description: Rounded share of topped ascents; absent without any ascent

AuditEntry.description: Who did what, to whom, when.

actorId.description: Absent if that member was deleted since

actorNickname.description: Nickname at the time of the action

targetLabel.description: Name at the time of the action

nextCursor.description: Pass it as ?cursor= for the next page; absent on the last page

AuthState.description: Whether this browser is signed in, and as whom.

badges.description: Every badge of the catalogue, in its order, earned or not

count.description: Times earned, 0 when not earned yet

Belay.description: A session where I held the rope; readable says whether I may open it.

BelayPage.description: nextCursor is absent on the last page.

ClimbedRoute.description: A route I climbed, and the last day I did.

CurrentMember.description: The signed-in member, as shown in the app shell.

avatarUrl.description: Profile photo, absent when the member has none

Device.description: An open session of the member ("Mes appareils").

id.description: Opaque id, not the session id

Directory.description: climberCount counts every active member, me included; members leaves me out.

replaceRouteId.description: One of my active favourites to give up for this one

Friend.description: since: when asked, or when accepted for a friend.

Friends.description: incoming: requests waiting for my answer; outgoing: the ones I sent. Newest first.

grades.description: Hardest grade first, only grades with a topped route

routes.description: Every route I climbed, dismounted ones included; latest first

LogbookGrade.description: Distinct routes topped at this grade, by the mode of their best ascent

LogbookTotals.description: Ascent counters count repeats; routeCount counts distinct routes; maxGrade and maxLeadGrade: the hardest topped, in any mode and in lead.

rememberMe.description: "Rester connecté": 180 days instead of the browser session

seniority.description: Years at the club (spec §9.4); absent without a year of arrival

MemberDetail.description: The member sheet, with what the caller may do.

underFifteenWithParentalConsent.description: Under 15, with a parental consent declared (no birth date)

canDelete.description: Delete the account for good (admin, not oneself)

MemberProfile.description: age is absent unless the member chose to show it.

MemberSummary.description: A line of the members table.

lastSeenAt.description: Roughly, to the hour; absent if never seen since registration

Meta.description: What is running on the server.

ModeratedComment.description: route for a comment on a route; climber and climbedOn for a comment on a session.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as ?cursor= for the next page; absent on the last page

routes.description: Routes on the wall during the month, climbed or not, and those climbed in it; most climbed first

total.description: Every route together: a climber of several routes counts once

MonthTotals.description: climbingDays: days with a session (two sessions on a day make one); toppedCount: topped ascents, repeats included; maxGrade: the hardest topped; averageFeeling: of the rated sessions.

MyProfile.description: Everything the member may see and edit about themselves.

age.description: Age today, when the birth date is known

parentalConsent.description: A parent or legal guardian agreed (declared under 15)

seniority.description: Years at the club (spec §9.4); absent without a year of arrival

MyRouteAscent.description: One of my ascents of the route.

PasswordResetLink.description: The secret of a reset link, shown once. The app builds the link with its own address: /nouveau-mot-de-passe#<token>.

PasswordResetTarget.description: Who a valid reset link is for.

days.description: Only the days with a session, earliest first

frozen.description: Its sessions can no longer change

ProfileUpdate.description: The whole editable profile, as the member wants it.

parentalConsent.description: Declares that a parent agreed; required once under 15

appearsInRankings.description: False when I chose not to appear in the rankings

ascents.description: Topped ascents, every mode, repeats included

freezesAt.description: When the month freezes; absent once frozen

sessions.description: Climbing days (two sessions on a day make one)

status.description: LIVE: this month; PROVISIONAL: last month, sessions may still be logged; FROZEN: final

lines.description: Best first; ties share a rank, then alphabetical order

me.description: My line, absent when I am not ranked

parentalConsent.description: Required when the birth date says under 15

password.description: 8 characters minimum, not a common password

RegistrationCodeSettings.description: Absent expiry or maximum: no limit.

RouteAttendance.description: A route and its ascents over a period.

RouteSettings.description: At least one setter or a setter note.

RouteStats.description: Ascents of the route by everyone.

leadPercent.description: Rounded share of ascents in lead; absent without any ascent

RouteSummary.description: A route as listed in the topo, with my own marks.

checks.description: Modes in which I can climb it

favorite.description: Whether it is one of my favourites

sectorIds.description: Every sector, in the new order

badges.description: The badges this session earned, in the catalogue order (a code twice when earned twice)

editable.description: Mine, and its month is not frozen yet

unlockedBadges.description: Right after saving it: the badges just unlocked, wherever they landed; empty otherwise

SessionPage.description: nextCursor is absent on the last page.

SessionReactions.description: One count per reaction, always all four in a fixed order; mine is absent if I gave none.

clientRef.description: Drawn by the app once per new session: sending it again gives back the session already saved (ignored on update)

climbedOn.description: Today or up to 7 days back

Streak.description: ISO weeks in a row with at least minDaysPerWeek climbing days, up to this week (which only counts once it has them).

Todo.description: Every route on the wall, easiest first. A route is on my list in a mode while its state is TODO; known in lead means known in top rope (FROM_LEAD).

TopoConfig.description: The club layout: sectors and their cords, hold colours, grades.
